selected_evidence.requirement: Local backend on TCP 8091 returns backend-ready
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the Python backend listening on 0.0.0.0:8091, its enabled/active service state, and successful direct responses containing backend-ready before and after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Reverse proxy on TCP 8090 publishes the backend
selected_evidence.summary: Shows valid nginx configuration, nginx listening on 8090, successful proxied responses, and matching nginx/backend log entries proving request forwarding.

Captures the healthy baseline with boot ID 151be410-d69a-4b38-8176-ab1916aae036, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID 9d2f28cc-89b7-4ca3-8723-2a9eb160e210, and recovered services, listeners, and response data.

ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m http.server 8091 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory /var/lib/backend8091

PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
